pages.text: The Mixer blends low-tier fuel into high-tier fuel with two recipes (2M per batch; speed upgrades increase throughput):$(li)$(bold)Advanced Mixture Fuel$(reset): 1000 mb End Mixture Fuel + 1000 mb Nether Compound Fuel → $(bold)1500 mb$(reset), a 50% volume bonus$(li)$(bold)Ultimate Mixture Fuel$(reset): 50 mb End Dragon Fuel + 50 mb Pure Fuel → 50 mb$(br2)Ultimate Mixture is the top tier of the line, with the highest heat value, and is intended for the highest-demand builds.

$(bold)Ingredient sources:$(reset)$(li)End Mixture Fuel ← the $(l:akaishi:fuel_liquefier)Energy Liquefier$(/l)'s End Mixture recipe$(li)Nether Compound and Pure Fuel ← the $(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l)$(li)End Dragon Fuel ← the Liquefier's Dragon Mixture recipe$(br2)Blended Advanced and Ultimate fuel is sent to the $(l:akaishi:fuel_canner)Fuel Canner$(/l), then to the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l).
The overview is in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l); canning and burning are linked above.
